no-storyboard.what: the film has a written plan (a storyboard, declared or found beside it)

no-authored-motion.what: something in the film is choreographed: a keyed `motion` track, or a layer that survives a junction

plain-slideshow.what: the film reaches past a slideshow: kinetic type, a camera move, or real transitions

crossfade-mud.what: no transition dissolves one text state into another in place

effect-soup.what: the film does not stack more effect families than it can spend

linear-motion.what: motion carries easing, not a constant rate

monotone-timing.what: the film varies its timing rather than moving everything alike

enter-and-retreat.what: a layer leaves the way it came, in one direction of travel

off-font.what: every face is one of the theme roles

restated-headline.what: a beat does not repeat the line above it

jargon.what: the on-screen words are specific, not marketing filler

no-preflight.what: the film went through the decision chain before the JSON existed

sparse-beats.what: the film has enough beats for its length, not two or three cards held too long

no-transition.what: a multi-beat film earns at least one real seam or cut, not flat jumps

craft-unvisited.what: every CRAFT doc that applies to this film is answered in the plan

feature-poverty.what: the film reaches into the engine's expressive families, not just the top of the box

static-bg.what: the backdrop moves, at least one beat is not a flat field asleep for the whole film

sweep-static.what: the rendered pixels move, the whole film is not one frozen frame held for its runtime
